method: Blind: candidates from scripts/shopify-rest-label-candidates.mjs (an independent text search that imports no pipeline code), then one AI-assisted reading pass by a fresh-context labelling agent that read the checkouts, used data/shopify-rest-deprecations.json as the reference list of removed endpoints, searched beyond the candidates, and never saw Refit output. Not hand labelling and not second-labelled.
selection: 20 apps: 10 from the 67 apps whose live code has REST usage by the candidate search, and 10 from the 133 without, each in seeded order (seededSample in scripts/ai-app-helpers.mjs, seed 20261022). None of the 200 is over Refit scan limits counted before scanning.

rules.rest: a line in live code that sends a Shopify REST Admin request (REST client call, REST resource class operation, or a fetch/axios to /admin/api/<version>/...json); GraphQL is not REST.
rules.removed: the request method and path match an entry of data/shopify-rest-deprecations.json; null when the method or path cannot be read

judgements: A helper that builds the URL is its own rest site (removed false when its callers pass literal paths), as are the call sites.
A src/app/api/.../test/route.ts API route was counted as live code.
